name: the-builder
description: Implementation tasks targeting the-builder member. Assertion-graded only (no LLM judge) so the suite is deterministic and CI-safe.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the fixed line and nothing else for: fix `total = price * qty` to also add tax.
Reply with ONLY a function signature and nothing else for: a function that validates an email string.
tasks.expectedOutput: A signature mentioning email or validate.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the refactored code and nothing else for: split a 200-line `processOrder` into smaller functions.
tasks.expectedOutput: Refactored code mentioning processOrder or order.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the added guard and nothing else for: reject negative quantities in `addToCart`.
tasks.expectedOutput: A guard mentioning quantity or negative.

tasks.input: Reply with ONLY the retry logic and nothing else for: retry a failed fetch up to 3 times.
tasks.expectedOutput: Retry logic mentioning retry or fetch.
